mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(stale),999999) FROM (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,MAX(completed_at),NOW()) stale FROM t_import_batch WHERE source_channel IN ('JIRA','QUALITY','REDBLACK') AND batch_status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIAL_SUCCESS') GROUP BY source_channel) x
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_import_batch WHERE batch_status='FAILED' AND updated_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_rows),0) FROM t_import_batch WHERE completed_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
SELECT COALESCE(100*SUM(failed_rows)/NULLIF(SUM(total_rows),0),0) FROM t_import_batch WHERE completed_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quality_total_rows),0) FROM t_import_batch WHERE quality_calculated_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
